transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (707x783) screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Companion record: nodate_takakkaw_falls_2013_01_18_en_b18daa (English export of the same pit, same content). Printed date 18/01/2013 (D/M/Y) agrees with the file name. Site name printed 'takkakaw' (misspelled) - transcribed as printed. Height axis uniform: 2.7 px/cm, 150 cm at the top gridline, 0 at the bottom. Boundaries 140/127/92/68/46/31/26/10/0 from bar edges (each bar's top border row falls on an integer cm) and H-column leader lines; the table here is drawn at the chart heights. Hardness axis non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F at 216/108/54/27/~13 px from the bar origin). Bars: F, 4F+ (6 px past 4F), 1F- (7 px short of 1F), P, P+ (40 px past P), P+, 1F, P+; the R-column icons agree with every bar. Temperatures on 13.5 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline). No marker at the surface: the dashed air segment (from -2.6 at the plot top) runs straight into the solid line to the 130 cm marker (printed surface temp -3.0 kept in header notes only). Markers 130-70 cm are clear; 60-0 cm lie inside the hatched bars (located by ring detection and visually, +-0.2 C; the 10 and 0 cm values are line positions, markers not distinguishable). Surface glyph asterisk over a triangle is unmapped (guide rule).
